with it as (

with actual as (
  select si.sku,
    (array_agg(coalesce(c.gold, 0) + coalesce(c.labor, 0) order by s.order_date desc))[1] / greatest(max(si.quantity), 1) as unit_cost_cents
  from (
    select sale_item_id,
      sum(amount_cents) filter (where cost_kind = 'gold') as gold,
      sum(amount_cents) filter (where cost_kind = 'labor') as labor
    from costs
    where org_id = '9d0336c0-8772-456d-a80c-a5f2cfe7bbd0' and source in ('manual', 'invoice') and cost_kind in ('gold', 'labor')
    group by sale_item_id) c
  join sale_items si on si.id = c.sale_item_id
  join sales s on s.id = si.sale_id
  group by si.sku)
select count(*) as variants_priced_below_actual_cost,
       coalesce(sum(a.unit_cost_cents - floor(pv.price_cents * (1 - coalesce(p.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0) * (1 - 0.128) - 45)), 0) as gap_cents
from actual a
join product_variants pv on pv.org_id = '9d0336c0-8772-456d-a80c-a5f2cfe7bbd0' and pv.sku = a.sku
join products p on p.id = pv.product_id
where pv.active
  and pv.price_cents * (1 - coalesce(p.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0) * (1 - 0.128) - 45 < a.unit_cost_cents
